spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's example verbatim — uareplacestart/uareplaceend listeners plus the initial replacedByUserAgent check — against a real img element, hiding exactly the companions the explainer says become wrong (zoom control, size copy).

interactive.rationale: Rehearsal buttons dispatch synthetic events through the real listeners; the zoom button, replaced-state tag, and log all respond live; button enablement tracks state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real listeners plus clearly-labelled synthetic rehearsal with isTrusted printed; behavior matches.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers surface-not-exposed (listeners still work, initial check honestly skipped), pre-script replacement via the initial check, and revert; every log line carries isTrusted so rehearsal can never masquerade as the real feature.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864; page links siblings.

conformance.rationale: The suite's synthetic-events-untrusted assertion proves the rehearsal mechanism's honesty; the trusted-path contract is a manual assertion as it requires a real replacement feature.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: rehearsal start hid the zoom control (computed display none) and showed the replaced tag; end restored inline-block; log recorded isTrusted=false on both; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on both handled transitions record the trusted flag and the resulting card state.

design_system.rationale: Replaced tag uses text-black bg + ivory text; product image is an inline SVG data URI (no external fetch); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Product image has meaningful alt text; status is role=status aria-live and log role=log; state is text-borne (the tag and status), not colour-only; native buttons with managed disabled state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Card/panel grid collapses under 720px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the trusted path when a real replacement feature exists
openQuestions.detail: No Chrome build in this environment ships a user-invocable image-replacement feature. When one exists (e.g. generative try-on behind the trial), verify the trusted events drive the same wiring and the initial replacedByUserAgent check catches pre-script replacement.

guidanceConsulted.query: image card overlay controls show hide state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Toggle visibility via class-driven display changes kept in CSS, not inline style juggling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The replaced state is a single .replaced class on the card; CSS owns which companions hide.

guidanceConsulted.query: state change announcement synthetic events live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce state transitions in text via live regions and never rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status line and event log are aria-live and carry the isTrusted flag textually.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive product card two column collapse
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: minmax(0,…) columns and min-width:0 to avoid content-forced overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Stage grid uses minmax(0,20rem) 1fr collapsing under 720px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the rehearsal path drives the real listeners end-to-end on Chromium 141 — zoom control provably hides and restores (computed styles checked), the replaced tag renders, and every event logs isTrusted=false. The trusted path needs a real replacement feature and is recorded as the open question.
